test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 31 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

Access to clean water

P. and requiring urgent policy action

Q. in many developing regions

R. affecting health and hygiene

S. remains a challenge
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1)** i.e. **SQRP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with **"S"**, stating that "Access to clean water remains a challenge."
 
• The next part, **"Q,"** adds context by specifying "in many developing regions."
 
• **Part "R"** follows by explaining the impact, "affecting health and hygiene."
 
• **Finally, part "P"** concludes with "and requiring urgent policy action," completing the sentence meaningfully.

Therefore, the correct answer is **SQRP.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (PRSQ):** This option starts with "and requiring urgent policy action," which is abrupt and does not introduce the subject properly.
 
• **Option 3 (SRPQ):** This sequence disrupts the logical flow, placing "affecting health and hygiene" before specifying the regions.
 
• **Option 4 (QPSR):** This arrangement starts with "in many developing regions and requiring urgent policy action," which creates a fragmented sentence.
